offering_description.value: Provides less-than-truckload freight transportation across the United States, with service to Canada and Mexico, for business shippers. It moves shipments through a network of owned terminals and company-operated trucks, with a focus on time-definite delivery.

primary_services.value: less-than-truckload freight transportation; time-definite and guaranteed delivery; cross-border freight to Canada and Mexico; freight consolidation and tracking

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, retailers, distributors and other businesses shipping palletized and partial-truckload freight

end_markets.value: manufacturing; retail; wholesale distribution; construction; automotive; industrial goods

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight charges and accessorial fees paid by shippers for transporting shipments

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells freight transportation to shippers, who pay per shipment based on weight, class and distance; asset operator: owns and runs a network of service centers, terminals and tractor-trailer fleet

geography_served.value: North America: 48 contiguous US states, plus Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line: less-than-truckload freight transportation services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff and national accounts serving business shippers; own locations: service centers and terminals where freight is picked up and delivered; online: website and electronic tools for quoting, booking and tracking shipments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: US DOT and FMCSA trucking safety, hours-of-service, hazardous materials and environmental rules apply
